reviews.title: Please stop these announcements
reviews.text:
Half the time when I open this app I am forced through a series of announcements. 

I am a designer. I understand the excitement of new features and the desire for users to know about them.

But you've got to see this from the user's perspective.

When I launch this app it because I need some white noise right now. 

That is not the time to force me through a non-optional lesson in all the ways you, you, you have improved this app.

The improvement in the experience most needed from you is respect for your users. 

This app is like a waiter at a restaurant who wants to be the center of attention, who wants to be noticed and watched like an actor on a stage. Instead of quietly keeping the water glass full he wants to interrupt the conversation to call attention to how he pours the water without adding too much ice. How the water glass is never left empty, because he is here to refill it. Perhaps he sins a song about his career as a waiter, and all the lessons he has learned about excellent service experiences.

reviews.title: Does not get along with Alexa+
reviews.text: Great app. I’ve been Brown Noise for years to sleep. I set it from my Echo Dot before I go to bed. The new Alexa+ does not recognize this app audibly, however. I’ve tried wording it many different ways. I can get it to work manually by disabling the skill in the Alexa app, then enabling it again. But this has to be repeated each time I want to turn on the White Noise app. Alexa+ defaults to Alexa Ambient Sounds, which does not loop like the White Noise app does. I’ve gone back to the original Alexa which still works for this. Please fix the issue with Alexa+.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text:
When I was in college in 2009, I searched for “white noise” in the App store. There this app was, and throughout the years and dozens of apps, this is still my most used.

I have recorded different showers and vent noises over the years and I mix them together for some great sleeping.  I can’t sleep without this app. I have downloaded many sounds from the devs market app; here community members upload sounds from all over the world. I appreciate everyone that participates there.

This has had great updates over the years. I will be spending my next ten years with this app. I’d even bet that I will use this until my final days. Nothing has been able to replace it, and I have owned many different white noise machines. 

I love you devs, thank you.
